daily_quota_parameter: finite nonnegative research setting; 81-day total must remain finite
chapter3: constant actual daily total; sum(action) must equal daily_quota_m3
chapters4_to_6: one budget of 81 * daily_quota_m3, shared across all 81 days
daily_supply_limit: whole seasonal budget as mathematical upper bound; no separately calibrated engineering capacity
regional_supply_limit: none imposed; no calibrated region-specific delivery capacity
provenance: research_setting: fixed 10000 m3/day in the default persistent drought case; selected below a conservative all-policy current-stress-refill bound, not by reward or a demand ratio; no runtime demand scaling; not measured supply
allowance_selection: fixed 10000 m3/day; supported by the all-policy scarcity certificate, not chosen as a demand ratio
reference_demand_status: historical v1 scale reference only; not the basis of v2 allowance or runtime daily quotas
reference_ratio_identity: default seasonal research allowance divided by the archived 81-day reference demand total; descriptive ratio, not a runtime quota multiplier
